stages.answer_line: (ARCHITECTURE): Part III is a constitutional operating system, not a bare catalogue: Articles 12-13 identify bound power and invalid law, Articles 14-30 secure six present rights, Article 32 supplies the remedy, and Articles 31A-35 plus 358-359 control exceptional protection or enforcement.
